findings.title: Registry shape probe can run Proxy traps on a preoccupied value
findings.evidence: packages/storage/src/maintenance.ts:83-102 isAheMaintenanceRegistry calls Object.getPrototypeOf, Object.isFrozen, Reflect.ownKeys and Object.getOwnPropertyDescriptor on descriptor.value at module initialization (line 138).
findings.impact: The design's prohibition is honored: the globalThis accessor is never invoked because only the descriptor is read (line 105) and "value" in descriptor gates reuse (line 108). But if the preoccupied data value were a Proxy, its traps would execute during import; the try/catch converts throws into the required TypeError refusal. This is outside the stated threat model (hostile same-process JS) and has no effect on tests 07-09.
findings.required_action: No code change in f5b0z. Root records this as an accepted boundary note in the D.110c-0c1f5b0z roadmap record.
